summary: Frontend-only focused retest completed on preview URL. Verified Edit Targets auto macro recalculation and macro-method sheet close reliability on 390x844 and 320x568.
critical_code_review_comments: Sheet body-height budgeting using measured header/footer appears to resolve prior close-button viewport/tap reliability issue.
Edit Targets auto mode now correctly updates protein with calorie changes (not only carbs/fat) in UI flow.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh login performed. Flow: Home (home-buddy-avatar) -> You tab -> Edit Targets. Confirmed 2400=>P111/C309/F80 and 2100=>P97/C270/F70 after auto mode ON. Macro method sheet opened from scrolled editor, scrolled to macro-source-mifflin, and closed via macro-method-close without force at both 390x844 and 320x568.
